title: Pipeline stage targets
subtitle: How long a deal may sit at a stage before we flag it. It isn't a constraint: it's a revealer — it says where the pipe is stuck, not who is late.
daysFor: Target duration for the "{{stage}}" stage, in days
saveFailed: I couldn't save that target duration.
errorMessage: I couldn't read the target durations.
wonNote: The "Signed" stage has no target duration, and accepts none: a signed deal doesn't age in its column.
staleNote: This duration also drives the stagnation alert on pipeline cards: flagged at the duration, orange at double, alert at four times. An untuned stage keeps 7, 14 and 30 days.
readOnlyNote: You can read these durations; only the workspace owner or an administrator can change them.
